stories.story: Lily wanted to fly a kite, but the kite was torn. Lily said, “I want to repair the kite.” Dad said, “The paper is thin.” Lily said, “I want to make a sail.” Dad cut a small sail from the kite with the scissors. Lily tied the sail to the boat with the string. She set the boat on the pond. Lily and Dad watched the boat. The boat sailed across the pond.
